snippet.title: Before Close - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
#games #horrorgame #indiegame 

Before Close is a short indie horror game where you play as Jared, a janitor on his usual night shift at a quiet, run-down laundromat. But tonight feels different. Walt, the usually chatty cashier, is distant and evasive, warning Jared to stay away from the back hallway due to a burst pipe—an excuse that quickly unravels.

As the night wears on, strange noises, flickering lights, and Walt’s sudden departure leave Jared alone with his growing unease. Drawn by suspicion, he begins to investigate—and discovers that something sinister is hidden in the back, something he was never meant to find.

The deeper Jared goes, the more distorted the familiar setting becomes. Some doors stay closed for a reason… and not every night ends the way it should.|

MUSIC USED IN THE TRAILER IS NOT MINE, IT IS FROM THE MINDS EYE PACK ON ITCH.IO
